openAlex.confirm: Send the DOI {doi} to OpenAlex (api.openalex.org) to find the works it cites?
openAlex.fill.noDoi: This is not a source note with a DOI. Give it type: source and a doi: property first.
openAlex.fill.off: The OpenAlex lookup is off. Turn it on in Settings → Privacy. Nothing was sent.
openAlex.fill.queued: References waiting for your approval in Property proposals: {n}
openAlex.fill.saveFirst: Save the note first: the references are proposed on its saved text.
openAlex.fill.unchanged: OpenAlex lists no references that this note does not already have.
openAlex.note: Off by default. While it is on, each lookup still asks first, and only the DOI is sent, to api.openalex.org. The privacy ledger lists every request.
openAlex.switch: Look up the references of a DOI in OpenAlex
openAlex.title: OpenAlex (citation graph)
